is_anopheles.evidence: This is a theoretical/computational simulation study; no actual mosquitoes were collected or tested, though Anopheles gambiae is referenced conceptually (e.g. page 4, 29).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No specific resistance markers were genotyped. Target markers like ace-1 and kdr are only mentioned conceptually in the discussion (page 29).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The study reports only simulated population genetics data generated by mathematical models, with no empirical mosquito genotype data.

african_field_population.evidence: No field mosquito populations were sampled or tested.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a pure mathematical and computer simulation modeling study ('A Two-Locus Model of the Evolution of Insecticide Resistance...', page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Not applicable to a theoretical modeling study.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Not applicable to a theoretical modeling study.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Theoretical modeling study with no empirical mosquito specimens.

supplement.evidence: No empirical field data or supplements required.

assessment.summary: This article describes a population genetics simulation model exploring the evolution of insecticide resistance under mixture versus sequential insecticide deployment strategies. It contains no empirical mosquito collection or marker genotyping data.
